metrics: Runtime identity, package versions, free and peak GPU memory, generation time, output frame count, and artifact hashes.
Post-step latent coverage at zero-based steps 0, 9, 19, 29, 39, and 49; each snapshot labels the scheduler timestep whose transition produced that state.
Pooled transformer summaries for six evenly spaced blocks at the same six denoising steps, retaining the guidance batch without branch aggregation.

Low-resolution 8×12 spatial transformer summaries for three evenly spaced blocks at zero-based steps 0, 29, and 49, testing whether selected block states retain local mug/holder layout after spatial pooling.
Scheduler-returned predicted-clean x0 latents at zero-based steps 0, 9, 19, 29, 39, and 49, testing whether cleaner intermediate samples contain information useful for later object-state probes.
Same-seed equality for all captured post-step latents, predicted-clean latents, pooled hidden summaries, spatial maps, and decoded RGB frames.

Dense decoded-frame scoring for all frame indices 0–48: a blinded reviewer records object visibility, scene identity/continuity, task stage, mug-to-holder relation, and gripper-to-mug proximity/apparent contact; post-run evaluators record visible mug/holder/gripper masks or boxes, centers, apparent area, CoTracker point tracks, and background-landmark motion. Save one ordered row per frame, including uncertainty and missingness reasons. These are image-space proxies; do not report metric 3D scale or physical contact.
held_out_evaluator: After generation, a reviewer who did not inspect teacher outputs scores all 49 decoded RGB frames for object visibility, scene identity/continuity, task-stage plausibility, mug-to-holder relation, and gripper-to-mug proximity/apparent contact. The original eight preselected temporal samples remain a sentinel subset only; they never replace full-frame review. If baseline and replay frames are bitwise equal, the same 49 reviewed frame rows map to both passes; any divergence is recorded by frame index and reviewed separately. This n=1 smoke review is not a seed-held-out evaluation and does not validate physical geometry.

post_run_review_artifact.format: JSON Lines; one ordered record for each frame_index 0–48
post_run_review_artifact.required_links: Each record links baseline and replay PNG paths and SHA-256 values, plus pixel equality; if the pair is equal, one review payload may be shared, and if it differs, retain separate review payloads for that index.
post_run_review_artifact.required_measurements: Reviewer labels, all-frame mask/track/background proxies, confidence, uncertainty, and explicit missingness/occlusion reasons as specified by metrics.
post_run_review_artifact.archive_update: After the result ZIP is downloaded and extracted, write this post-run file, add its SHA-256 to manifest.json artifact_sha256, and repackage the reviewed run. Leave the pre-replay baseline checkpoint unchanged and baseline-only.
post_run_review_artifact.sentinel_note: The local source records do not preserve the legacy eight sentinel indices. Do not infer them from latent anchors or another schedule. Tag the legacy subset only if its exact prior index list is recovered; the all-49 review remains required either way.

success_threshold: The smoke gate passes only if the runtime is a Tesla T4 at compute capability 7.5; all configured post-step latent, pooled hidden-summary, spatial-map, and predicted-clean keys are captured exactly once; 49 frames are returned; a complete ordered frame-score table covers indices 0–48 with explicit uncertainty/missingness; all captured tensors and decoded frames are bitwise equal in the same-seed replay; and the human review confirms that the condition and intended mug/holder action are scoreable. Attention capture remains deferred and explicitly labeled in the packet.
falsification_condition: The feasibility hypothesis fails for this pinned route if the free T4 cannot load or finish generation, callback or hook indexing is incomplete or ambiguous, spatial tokens do not match the pinned latent patch grid, predicted-clean scheduler semantics differ from the pinned DDIM/v-prediction route, requested output length is not returned, any replay tensor or frame diverges within the same runtime, the frame-score table omits a decoded frame, or the scene is not scoreable by the blinded review. Any such result triggers a documented adapter/configuration revision or candidate-model review; it does not justify a geometry-policy claim.
